journey.name: onchain original payment retry
journey.description: Verifies explicit fee approval and normal spend authentication for retrying one original software on-chain payment. Precondition: an onboarded funded dev wallet, PIN enabled, a synced node, and a retained unresolved prepared-send receipt with its exact original recipient, amount, inputs and candidate transaction IDs. Creating a controlled refusal or response-loss fixture is not provided by the Capabilities table and remains in Manual Tests. A seeded Pending fixture must be labelled as state injection, never as proof of a native fault. Manual Tests must verify the exact backend winning transaction retains the complete original input set and recipient amount, and any original Shop request or Blocktank order completes once without a new request or order. Local activity alone cannot prove these checks. This journey is currently unrun on rc69.

actions.action: Open the retained original payment's Pending screen and record its displayed transaction ID
Verify Pending describes the unresolved outcome and offers Retry original payment
Verify the dialog shows the original recipient and amount and prefills the original fee rate
Enter an invalid fee rate of 73786976294838207 sat/vB and verify valid positive fee feedback appears and Authorize retry is disabled
Enter a valid authorized fee rate that the funded fixture can support and tap Authorize retry
Verify the normal payment PIN screen appears before dispatch
Go Back without entering the PIN and verify the original Pending payment remains retained
Tap Retry original payment again, choose the fixture-supported fee and tap Authorize retry
Enter the fixture's normal payment PIN without recording entered digits
Wait for Bitcoin Sent only after exact positive evidence, or verify Pending remains with a readable error if fee headroom is insufficient
If successful, tap Details then Explore and record the exact winning transaction ID shown by TXID
